title: Research on Classification Method of Medical Ultrasound Image Processing Based on Neural Network.
summary: Transfer-learned CNNs classified thyroid-nodule ultrasound images against pathology labels, a disease-specific diagnostic task.
ai_technology: Cascaded/transfer-learned CNNs process ultrasound images after image-quality and ROI filtering.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The Results section reports classification of thyroid nodular lesions and compares the candidate CNN models on held-out images.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective image collection with internal model comparisons; no independent-centre test or clinical benefit evaluation.
